components.css: .ds-theme{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle,#1d1d22);border-radius:8px;background:var(--color-surface-container-lowest,#050506);color:var(--color-primary,#ffffff);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform .15s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.ds-theme:hover{border-color:var(--color-outline,#8e9192)}.ds-theme:active{transform:scale(.95)}.ds-theme:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-outline,#8e9192);outline-offset:2px}.ds-theme-ring{position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:9999px;background:currentColor;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),background-color .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.ds-theme-dot{position:absolute;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:9999px;background:currentColor;opacity:0;transform:translateX(6px);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),opacity .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.ds-theme:hover .ds-theme-ring{transform:translateX(-6px);background:transparent}.ds-theme:hover .ds-theme-dot{opacity:1;transform:translateX(8px)}@media (pointer:coarse){.ds-theme{width:44px;height:44px}}

narrative.overview:
A black bench under one lamp. The page is a single centred column on a true-black canvas, and the only thing lit is the work: white headings, soft-white copy, screenshots and the contribution grid. Everything that is tooling rather than work (the clock, the lofi player, the menu, the theme switch, the cursor ring) sits at the edges in header-sized, hairline-bordered controls set in muted mono, present but dim. The mood is focused, confident, quiet. Nothing shouts; hierarchy comes from scale, weight and tonal contrast, never from colour or decoration.

Density is airy but disciplined. Major sections stand 96 px apart on a phone and 128 px apart on a desk, so each reads as its own island, while inside a section the rhythm tightens to a 4 px grid with 40 px between heading and content. Structure is drawn with 1 px hairlines and tonal steps a few points apart; surfaces never float. The one accent is the absence of accent: pure white is the primary colour, spent on the name, headings and the single call to action, and the four status hues appear only as dots.

The bench has a day setting. The light theme is a full peer, not an afterthought: every token has a light value, the canvas becomes pure white, and the hero banner cross-fades from night to day. Phones are a first-class reader, so the system is specified at 320 px upward, with 44 px targets wherever the pointer is a finger. The look preserves the identity of the earlier "Technical Precision" system; what changed is the values, the contrast and the layout discipline.
keyCharacteristics: True-black canvas (#000000) with cards a hair above it; depth by tone and hairline, never by shadow at rest.
White as the only emphasis; colour reserved for 8 px status dots and the error state.
Geist for reading, JetBrains Mono (one weight) for every label, control and datum.
Hover brightens an edge; press scales to 95%; reveals rise 16 px once. One easing curve everywhere.
A dotted 284 × 112 px lattice behind the page that the theme wipe, the generative covers and the banner all echo.
Two themes with equal rigour, 44 px touch targets, reduced-motion respected throughout.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Pure white is emphasis, and emphasis is rare: the name, section headings, card titles, one primary button. Body text is Soft White, never white.

rules.name: The Dot-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Live, Building and Archive hues appear as 8 px dots (and the 6 px availability pulse), never as fills, borders or text. Two exceptions: Error Rose inside the contact form, and Live Green on the sent-message check and one bar in seven of an escrow cover.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Boundaries are 1 px of Hairline over a tonal step of at most two ramp positions. If a surface needs more separation than that, it is the wrong surface.

rules.name: The Mono Means Metadata Rule
rules.body: If the text is about the page (a label, a control, a date, a count, a shortcut), it is JetBrains Mono. If it is for reading, it is Geist. Never mix within one element.

rules.name: The Single-Weight Mono Rule
rules.body: Only JetBrains Mono 500 is shipped. Mono text never asks for bold or regular; emphasis in mono comes from colour (Pewter to Soft White to Lamp White), not weight.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Every Geist heading at 24 px or larger carries −0.025em tracking. Body text keeps its natural tracking; captions widen.

rules.name: The 44 px Rule
rules.body: Any element a thumb can tap is at least 44 px on its shorter side on a coarse pointer, including text links in the hero and footer, which get the height through padding, not font size.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: In-page surfaces never carry a drop shadow, in either theme. If something must float, it is a modal, and it gets the Overlay shadow and the scrim.

rules.name: The Brightening Edge Rule
rules.body: Hover and focus change a colour, not a position: the border goes to Lit Edge, the text goes up one text step. Position changes are reserved for the press (scale 0.95) and the first-view reveal.

dos: Do build every container as Bench Black with a 1 px Hairline and a 12 px radius, and every control as an 8 px-radius surface that brightens its edge to Lit Edge on hover.
Do give any tappable element at least 44 px on a coarse pointer, using padding on text links so the type size stays 12 px.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) for every transition and check prefers-reduced-motion before any animation, including springs and infinite loops.
Do keep Pewter for 11–12 px metadata only on True Black or Bench Black, where it holds 5.7:1 or better.
Do mark a link that leaves the site with the 14 px arrow glyph and open it in a new tab; keep in-page navigation as real anchors.
Do define both theme values for any new token, in the @theme block and the html[data-theme="light"] override.
Do draw new icons on the 24-unit grid at a 2 px stroke in currentColor, and take brand marks from simple-icons.
Do keep JetBrains Mono at weight 500 and reserve it for labels, controls and data.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow, gradient fill or glow to a surface in the page flow, in either theme; only the palette overlay and the cover glyph carry shadows.
Don't use Live Green, Building Amber or Archive Zinc as a fill, border or text colour; they are 8 px dots.
Don't put an eyebrow, index number or decorative label above a section heading; the heading carries its own weight.
Don't lay projects out as a grid of identical cards; featured work gets the 5/7 row and the rest the disclosure list.
Don't set interface text below 10 px, or anything a visitor must read below 11 px; only decorative lettering inside a cover may go smaller.
Don't type a unicode arrow, bullet or emoji where an icon belongs.
Don't fire single-key shortcuts outside the open palette, or focus a text field when the dialog opens on a touch screen.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or a brand colour; emphasis is Lamp White and rarity.
